title: fix(fields): the read-only GridField table reads every non-lookup cell through displayText (objectui#12915)
body:
Fixes #12915
Clause-②: no

## What changed

- The read-only `GridField` table cell (`packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx`) sent only `file` and date / datetime / time cells through `displayText` and printed every other cell with `String(value)`. Every cell except a lookup now goes through `displayText(c, row[c.name], displayLocale, currency)`. That is the same call, with the same locale and currency, that the list-mode and computed cells already use, so the read-only and editable views of one row read alike. Lookup cells still render through `LookupField`. No second formatter, and no prop, export or language-pack key.
- One stale comment in `GridField.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx` (it said the read-only number cells print the stored value) is updated. No assertion changed.
- Changeset `.changeset/12915-gridfield-readonly-display.md` (`@object-ui/fields` patch).

## Print path

The showcase invoice's default record page `showcase_invoice_document` is also its print page (it declares `print`), and its `record:line_items` block declares `readonly: true`. `LineItemsPanel` renders `LineItemsField` (= `GridField`) with `readonly={schema.readonly}`. Screen and print are the same component, so this one change covers both.

## Pin

New `packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.readonlyCells-12915.test.tsx`, a read-only table in a de-DE session with EUR:

- a select cell reads `Open` (stored `open`);
- a number cell reads `1.234,5`;
- a currency cell reads `98.765,25 €`;
- CONTROL: the lookup cell equals a standalone read-only `LookupField` with the same props, the file cell reads `spec.pdf`, and the date cell reads `17. Juni 2024`.

Ablation, after the fix was committed (`bdcf364`): main's exact three-way block was restored with `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `46a85c34211a` to `8e7d43f95c17`, which is main's blob). The select, number and currency tests went red (received `open`, `1234.5`, `98765.25`) and the control stayed green. After the restore the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Live evidence (never-merged branch `claude/issue-12915-evidence`, `cdea0aeb09e3`)

Published backend 18.0.0-next.3 with the showcase app, the console dev server and Chromium. Invoice INV-1001, en session:

| leg | Qty | Unit Price | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| main, screen and print | 10 | 150 | 1500 |
| branch, screen and print | 10 | 150 | 1,500 |

- https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/cdea0aeb09e312ca4bcf09e0f9663f5b40f41816/evidence/12915/README.md
- https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/cdea0aeb09e312ca4bcf09e0f9663f5b40f41816/evidence/12915/branch-screen-table.png
- https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/cdea0aeb09e312ca4bcf09e0f9663f5b40f41816/evidence/12915/branch-print-preview.png
- https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/cdea0aeb09e312ca4bcf09e0f9663f5b40f41816/evidence/12915/main-print-preview.png

The showcase has no select column on an invoice line, so the select label is measured by the pin only.

## Local gates (head 0b6f62a)

- fields build closure and `type-check`: pass
- 136 GridField / LineItemsPanel / MasterDetailForm / line_items test files: pass
- `@object-ui/fields` test: pass
- changeset-claims, changeset:check, test-path-roots, new-line-citations, changeset-presence: pass
- eslint: 0 errors

## Acceptance notes

- A number with more than three decimals now shows rounded to three (`toLocaleString`), as list mode already does.
- The live session resolves no currency, so currency cells show no symbol and no fixed two decimals on either leg. That is a configuration reading, not this change.
- `displayText`'s English `N files` / `File` text, and the English Yes / No options that hydration gives boolean columns, are pre-existing and out of scope.
